question: In which of the following parts of India are thorn forests and scrub forests found?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North-western India.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Thorn forests and scrub forests in India are typically found in **regions with dry, arid, or semi-arid climates.**
 
• These forests are characterized by thorny trees and shrubs that are adapted to withstand **hot temperatures and low rainfall.**
 
• These forests thrive in areas that receive** less than 70 cm of annual rainfall **and are adapted to harsh, water-scarce environments.
 
• **Northwestern India:**
 
 
• Rajasthan Particularly in the **Thar Desert region**, where conditions are **extremely dry.**
 
• Gujarat In the dry regions of **Kutch and Saurashtra.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central India (Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh):**

 
 
• Areas with low rainfall in Madhya Pradesh and the **Bundelkhand region** (spanning parts of Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh) have significant thorn and scrub forest cover.
 
 
 
 
• **Southern India (Rayalaseema, Telangana, and Northern Karnataka)**:
 
 
• Dry areas in Andhra Pradesh **(Rayalaseema),** Telangana, and **northern Karnataka** are prominent regions where scrub and thorn forests are found, due to the hot and semi-arid climate.
 
 
 
• **Southeastern Tamil Nadu**:
 
 
• Southeastern parts of **Tamil Nadu**, especially in the rain-shadow regions, support thorn and scrub forests, adapted to **low moisture and high temperatures.**
